integrity: Finite evidence is complete enumeration from independently implemented Python and C++17 programs for orders 2, 3, and 4. The symbolic proof covers all prime powers. No third-party certification or independent review is asserted.
scientific_limitations: General proof is restricted to Desarguesian finite planes. Complete mixed-seed time enumeration is exact only for q=4; other extension-field optimizer counts and completion times are not asserted. Subfield-generation and five-point colour-individualization are prior literature, not independently claimed novel. Unindexed historical overlaps remain possible.
title: Prime-field threshold and minimum-seed speed spectrum for two-neighbor bootstrap on projective-plane incidence graphs
